name: LMR51430
description: 36 V, 3 A synchronous buck in SOT-23-6, pin-compatible with the TPS54202, for 24 V robots that want the cheap SOT-23 layout.
notes: X = 500 kHz, Y = 1.1 MHz; the XF/YF variants are forced PWM.
Pin-to-pin compatible with TPS54202/TPS54302, but with a 36 V rating.

en.note: Precision enable; must NOT float (floating = disabled, unlike the pin-compatible TPS54202/TPS54302). Simplest: tie EN to VIN. Abs max is VIN + 0.3 V (38 V listed = VIN abs max); never drive EN with VIN at 0 V. Rising 1.227 V typ (1.36 V max), falling 1.08 V typ. Optional UVLO divider: VIN_RISING = VENH x (RENT + RENB)/RENB; design example RENB = 200k, RENT = 768k gives 6.0 V rising / 5.3 V falling.

notes: Fixed-frequency peak current mode, internally compensated, no Cff in the typical app. X = 500 kHz (450-560 kHz), Y = 1.1 MHz; F suffix (XF/YF) = FPWM, no F = PFM at light load.
LMIN = (VINmax - VOUT)/(IOUT x KIND) x VOUT/(VINmax x fSW) (eq. 11); KIND 0.2-0.6, design example 0.3. Inductor saturation current must exceed the peak current limit.
Load-step sizing (eq. 14, eight clock cycles): COUT > (1/2) x 8 x (IOH - IOL)/(fSW x dVOUT_SHOOT) (gives 48 µF for 1.5 A step, 250 mV, 500 kHz); ripple eq. 12-13. Design example: 2 x 22 µF 25 V X7R.
lTable is Table 9-1 (500 kHz, ceramic). Table 9-2 for 1.1 MHz (Y): 3.3 V 2.2 µH 2x10 µF; 5 V 3.3 µH 2x10 µF; 12 V 6.8 µH 3x10 µF; same 100k top / 22.1k, 13.7k, 5.23k bottom.
Feedback: VOUT = 0.6 x (1 + RFBT/RFBB); recommended RFBT range 10k-100k, do not exceed 1 MΩ. Tables µse RFBT = 100k.

Input: >= 4.7 µF X5R/X7R ceramic, voltage rating ~2x VINmax recommended; design µses 2 x 4.7 µF 50 V plus 0.1 µF HF cap close to pins (Fig 9-1 drawing shows 2.2 µF). Add 10-22 µF electrolytic bulk if the supply is more than a few inches away.
VOUT range 0.6 V to 95% of VIN (rec. op. conditions). tON_MIN 70 ns, tOFF_MIN 150 ns; frequency folds back (down to ~133 kHz) at min on/off time; DMAX 98%.
Current limits: high-side peak 4.76 A typ (3.67-6.68 A), low-side valley 3.5 A typ; IOUTmax ~= (ILS_LIMIT + ISC)/2. Hiccup after 256 cycles with FB < 40% VREF (135 ms off). Internal 4 ms soft start.
Boot cap 0.1 µF, 16 V or higher, X5R/X7R. Pin diagram calls the package DBV but orderables are SOT-23-THIN (DDC).
